_doc: LIVE vote-sheet registry for scripts/check_sheet_staleness.py (YL3 regen wave, MG ruling A 19-11-2026 — strict-on-live). live = open voting surfaces awaiting MG; a stale or meta-less live sheet FAILS CI. live_parked = live sheets that cannot be re-rendered today, each with its blocker and resolution path; reported as a loud WARN, never a fail. frozen/archived = never scanned. Everything else hosted under vote/sheets/ (closed decision records, superseded drafts, pre-vote triage pipelines) is logged as a regen queue, never a fail. A sheet hosted with current csl-pyutil passes by construction — register it under 'live' in the SAME pass that hosts it (the /review-sheet Phase 3-bis step), and drop the entry the moment its vote applies.
